name: diag.query
title: diag.query
summary: Diagnostics on the bus by code, severity, subject, origin, time or tick; grouped and budgeted by default.
html:
Diagnostics on the bus by code, severity, subject, origin, time or tick; grouped and budgeted by default.

  • Scope: read
  • Service: diag

#Params

ParamRequiredDescription
sessionyesSession handle from session.begin.
sinceOnly records new or repeated after this cursor (cursor of a previous call).
codesOnly these codes (ARA1302, ARA-EXP-AND-007).
severityMinimum severity (default info).
subjectsOnly records about these subjects: entity:e_8b21, name-free IDs (e_8b21), asset:@meshes/crate.glb, system:physics.step, pass:gbuffer, module:Gameplay.
originOnly records caused by engine, human, agent or agent:<name>.
fromMsOnly records last seen at or after this Unix time in milliseconds.
toMsOnly records last seen at or before this Unix time in milliseconds.
fromTickOnly records last seen at or after this simulation tick.
textOnly records whose message contains this text.
groupGroup records by code with counts, subjects and fixes (default true).
budgetApproximate size of the text answer in characters (default 2000).
limitMaximum records in entries, newest kept (default 10 grouped, 50 not).
